description: This file defines a Python class 'WakeNotifierFilter' which is a frame processor used to monitor specific types of frames and trigger notifications conditionally based on an asynchronous filter function. It is part of a pipeline processing system, likely related to network or media stream processing, where frames are processed with directional flow and notifications are triggered based on frame content.

classes.name: WakeNotifierFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that monitors specified frame types and executes an asynchronous filter callback to conditionally trigger a notifier, supporting conditional wake-up or notifications in a processing pipeline.
